title: Gasoline crack collapse -> JETS fade rally

message: NOISE: gasoline crack vs JETS r=0.05 n=389 perm p=0.74; z>1 long-JETS-5d rule 31 trades hit 55% avg +0.38% but excess vs buy-hold -0.05%, actionability 3.99
